subject: Buying path confirmation + security gating (BrightPath)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@brightpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T15:12:00Z
Subject: Quick recap & next steps — procurement path and security gating

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — enjoyed walking through the inference flow and how Redwood could lower token cost while keeping tail-latency predictable for BrightPath's triage pipeline. Two quick recaps and asks so we can align procurement and security next steps: 

1) Buying path: can you confirm whether BrightPath prefers to purchase via PO (invoice), corporate card, or via marketplace (AWS Marketplace)? If PO, please share the procurement contact and any PO template/terms. If marketplace is an option, we can often get a faster onboarding for a pilot.

2) Security gating: you mentioned your InfoSec will require SOC 2 Type II evidence and a signed DPA. Attached is our security questionnaire (for quick answers) and a draft DPA we can push through DocuSign. If you can share your procurement and security contacts (or attach your vendor questionnaire), we’ll fill it out and route to Legal.

3) Timeline ask: what target start date for a pilot would make sense (weeks)? This helps us scope invoice timing vs marketplace seat activation.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx, Redwood_DPA_Draft_for_BrightPath.pdf

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/389201

If helpful, I can loop in our contracts lead (Marissa) to own PO and DPA routing. Next step suggestion: you reply with procurement@brightpath.com and security contact; we’ll return a filled questionnaire and DocuSign DPA within 2 business days.

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for production LLMs
From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@brightpath.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:06:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps — procurement path and security gating

Sean —

Appreciate the follow-up and the materials. A few notes from our side after the call: 

- Preferred path: procurement would like to go PO for any long-term contract, but for a small pilot (30 days / limited throughput) we could route via corporate card or try AWS Marketplace to speed things up. So we may end up doing a short pilot on card/marketplace then convert to PO.
- Procurement contact: procurement@brightpath.com (cc'ing is fine). Budget owner is me (Tom Rivera).
- Security: our InfoSec team explicitly requested SOC 2 Type II and a vendor DPA. They also sent us a vendor questionnaire (attached in reply) — I pasted the questionnaire into your workbook where it applies. Can you confirm whether you have a current SOC 2 report to share or a timeline for when Type II will be available?
- DocuSign: yes, please send the DPA via DocuSign if possible. That will speed routing through our Legal.

Target pilot start: ideally by Sep 20th if we can spin up a short pilot quickly.

Thanks —
Tom
Tom Rivera
Director of Engineering Operations
BrightPath Health

Date: 2026-09-07T17:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps — procurement path and security gating

Tom / procurement team —

Great, thanks for the clarity. Quick responses to each item and proposed path forward: 

- PO vs card vs marketplace:
  * Pilot (short-term): corporate card or AWS Marketplace SKU gets you fastest time-to-first-request; no PO required and immediate billing.
  * Production (enterprise): PO with Net-30 invoices is standard. We can accept a PO referencing Redwood's master services agreement + SOW if needed. Converting from marketplace to PO later is straightforward (we'll coordinate with Accounting).

- SOC 2 / DPA: 
  * SOC 2: We currently have a SOC 2 Type I and expect Type II audit completion in Q4 2026. In the meantime we can share our SOC 2 readiness report, control matrices, and a summary of compensating controls.
  * DPA: attached is a draft DPA we typically use. I can route the final version via DocuSign — here is the link I will use: https://www.docusign.com/redwood/dpa/bp-2026-0089. If Legal wants redlines, please send them back to me and I'll loop in Marissa and our contracts counsel.
  * Questionnaire: I'll have our security ops team fill the attached sheet with responses to the items you pasted. Expect a completed pass in ~48 hours after I loop them in.

- Timeline / next steps: 
  1) You confirm pilot start date (you mentioned ~Sep 20).
  2) Procurement sends PO template or confirms marketplace/card.
  3) I route DPA via DocuSign; Marissa will coordinate any purchase order paperwork.

I've attached: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (UPDATED — added answers for common vendor questions) and Redwood_DPA_Draft_for_BrightPath.pdf.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/389201
Drive (security package): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-security-package

If procurement prefers, Marissa can be the primary contact for PO terms. Marissa — can you confirm our standard PO cadence and whether we can accept net-30 for this customer?

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@brightpath.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps — procurement path and security gating

Tom / Sean —

I'll own the DPA and PO flow. Quick answers: 

- PO terms: we can accept PO with Net-30 by default for enterprise deals. We also support Net-45 upon review but will need a brief credit check for Net-45.
- Marketplace: I will confirm available AWS Marketplace SKUs and plan; conversion guidance is 1) pilot on marketplace 2) submit PO referencing MSA + invoice number for production conversion.
- DocuSign: Sean — please send the DPA via the DocuSign link above; I'll monitor and expedite with Legal.

I'll also have Contracts send a formal invoice template and our standard MSA. Expect a DPA via DocuSign today and completed questionnaire back to you by end of day tomorrow.
